If you're looking for a wellness clinic to take care of your health, I highly recommend this place. The doctors are lovely and provide detailed and attentive information. The staff are polite and provide excellent service. I'm very impressed.

I've been a loyal customer for over 5 years, but today the service quality has plummeted. The queuing system is terrible. It seems they want everything to be easy, even with a sign saying "put the file on top, queue from the first file underneath," but the staff still cramped it up. I understand they want to speed things up, but they forgot to bring the file back to see the doctor until we were almost ready to pay and leave.
The queuing system was chaotic. There's a sign saying to put the file on top, and the queue will work its way up, but the staff just put the file at the bottom. In short, the queue is messy, and people who came later got in first. And this wasn't the first time; it happened twice in one day! I can honestly say the staff training is terrible. Although the staff tried their best to reduce the wait, they even offered an EKG while I waited for the doctor, but they either forgot or something and didn't bring me back to see the doctor until we were about to pay. The doctor went for lunch/fasting, so I kept waiting. Then, the doctor finished lunch and came back! Very impressive. I've been a regular customer for over 5 years, but I'm going to think twice before using their services again. If you haven't been here before, you can go somewhere else.

The staff were polite and the service was good. It was convenient and fast. I liked that it wasn't as crowded as going for a health checkup at a hospital. The place wasn't too small, which made me feel comfortable and not cramped. The waiting area was comfortable, and they provided water and snacks for those getting health checkups. There was ample parking, and it was easy to get there.

Coordination between the admin on the Line official account and the health checkup center might not be very good. I informed them via Line, but the staff at the counter weren't aware of any additional services I needed.

Overall service was okay; I didn't have to wait long.

The medical center is suitable for people who want to get a health check-up. It has modern equipment and staff ready. The place may not be very big because it is located in the RSU Tower building on Sukhumvit 31. Park your car at the building and take the elevator to the 11th floor. If traveling by BTS, get off at Phrom Phong station and walk about 400 meters. The building is right on the corner of the street.
